eyebrow: Runs after the change, before commit
code:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_Product_PriceAudit
ON Production.Product
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO dbo.ProductPriceAudit
        (ProductID, OldPrice, NewPrice)
    SELECT i.ProductID, d.ListPrice, i.ListPrice
    FROM inserted AS i
    JOIN deleted AS d ON d.ProductID = i.ProductID
    WHERE i.ListPrice <> d.ListPrice;
END;
caption: AFTER INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE — one trigger can cover all three events.

eyebrow: A trigger can roll back the whole operation
code:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_Product_NoNegativePrice
ON Production.Product
AFTER UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted WHERE ListPrice < 0)
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('ListPrice cannot be negative.', 16, 1);
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    END
END;
caption: Same transaction as the UPDATE — ROLLBACK here undoes the whole statement.
